sections.title: Linking
sections.note: The passwords that link your files. A file is either the first game (it gives the Secret to Holodrum) or the linked one.

items.name: Secret to Holodrum
items.howTo: Beat Veran in an unlinked Ages game. The ending gives you the Secret to Holodrum: enter it under 'Secrets' on a new Seasons file to play Seasons as the linked sequel (or link the two Game Boy Colors with a cable instead).
items.reward: A linked Oracle of Seasons game, continuing this file
items.notes: The secret carries over your animal companion and Bipin and Blossom's son.

items.name: Started with the Secret to Labrynna
items.howTo: Start this file under 'Secrets' with the Secret to Labrynna from a finished Seasons game. It begins with 4 hearts and adds the linked events: the Hero's Cave, Zelda in the Black Tower, the Piratians and Sea of Storms in the present, and Twinrova and Ganon after Veran.

items.name: Ring Secret
items.howTo: Ask the Red Snake at Vasu Jewelers for your Ring Secret and tell it to the Red Snake in the other game; then ask again and carry the merged secret back. It only works between files that share one linked history, and only once you've finished the game or started it with a secret.
items.reward: Your appraised rings merged into both files
items.notes: With two Game Boy Colors and a link cable, the Blue Snake does the same without a password; it can also give a Ring Fortune (one random ring each). Neither works on a Game Boy Advance or the 3DS.

items.name: Hero's Secret
items.howTo: At the end of a linked game, defeat Twinrova and Ganon in the Room of Rites. The ending gives you the Hero's Secret, which starts a new game in either Oracle.
items.after: The end of a linked game
items.reward: A Hero's game: an extra Heart Container at the start, the Victory Ring, and Ring Secrets shared with your earlier files
items.notes: Use it in the game you just finished to replay it unlinked, then link onward the other way round: the linked events (and rings like Power Ring L-3 and Armor Ring L-3) depend on which game came first. Finishing a Hero's linked game gives no new Hero's Secret.

sections.title: Secrets from Seasons
sections.note: If you played Ages first: secrets heard in the linked Seasons game, told here.

items.name: Fairy Secret
items.howTo: In your linked Seasons game, hear it from the woman by the fountain in the middle of Horon Village. Here, tell it to the blue Forest Fairy in Fairies' Woods. You also get a return secret; tell it to Farore in Seasons' Hall of Secrets to get the same reward there.

items.name: Mamamu Secret
items.howTo: In your linked Seasons game, hear it from Mamamu Yan's mother in the Floodgate Keeper's House in Spool Swamp. Here, tell it to Mamamu Yan in Lynna City. Find her lost dog somewhere in or just outside Lynna City and carry it back. You also get a return secret; tell it to Farore in Seasons' Hall of Secrets to get the same reward there.
items.notes: Zelda Wiki warns of a glitch where the dog vanishes for good: save before telling her the secret.

sections.title: Secrets for Seasons
sections.note: If this is the linked game: secrets heard here, told on your finished Seasons file.

items.name: Deku Secret
items.howTo: Hear it from the singing Deku Scrub in the far southwest of the Deku Forest (past). On your finished Seasons file, tell it to the Deku Scrub in a cave in eastern Natzu, near Moblin's Keep west of Sunken City. You get the reward there plus a return secret; tell that to Farore in the Hall of Secrets here to get the same reward in this game.

items.name: Graveyard Secret
items.howTo: Hear it from the Ghini outside Syrup's Potion Shop in Yoll Graveyard (say you believe what you see). On your finished Seasons file, tell it to the green Ghini in Holodrum's Graveyard, inside the one grave with no flowers (dig behind the tombstone second from the left in the first row). Red and blue Ghini copies flash by; say which there were more of, three times in a row. You get the reward there plus a return secret; tell that to Farore in the Hall of Secrets here to get the same reward in this game.
